$comment: Sample catalog for development and the Supabase seed. PRICES ARE PLACEHOLDERS until the owner sets them. Images live in apps/web/public/products. Regenerate supabase/seed.sql with `pnpm db:seed` after editing.

collections.name: Royal Heritage
collections.story: The throne of grace and a kingdom that cannot be shaken, carved in arches and ornament.

collections.name: Broken Bond
collections.story: Chains broken and death without dominion. Stand firm in what was won.

collections.name: Rolled Away
collections.story: The stone rolled away and the tomb empty at dawn. New life, worn plainly.

story.art: The tomb stands open at dawn, the stone rolled back and light spilling from the doorway beneath the wordmark.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, bone ink
story.back: Thornbound wordmark over the open tomb, rolled stone and rising sun
story.paraphrase: At dawn the women found the stone moved and the tomb empty. He had risen.
story.fit: Oversized tee · dropped shoulder, boxy body

back.alt: Third Morning back print: the open tomb at dawn with the stone rolled aside

front.alt: Third Morning front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: A ring of rusted chain breaks apart around the Thorn Cross, its links falling loose beneath the wordmark.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, bone ink
story.back: Thornbound wordmark over a ring of breaking chain around the Thorn Cross
story.paraphrase: Christ was raised and will never die again. Death has no hold on him.
story.fit: Oversized tee · dropped shoulder, boxy body

back.alt: Shattered Dominion back print: a ring of breaking chain around the cross

front.alt: Shattered Dominion front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: A carved arch frames the Thorn Cross above the wordmark, with olive branches gathered at its foot.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, bone ink
story.back: Gothic arch, Thorn Cross and olive branches around the wordmark
story.paraphrase: Come boldly to the throne of grace and find mercy and help when you need it.
story.fit: Oversized tee · dropped shoulder, boxy body

back.alt: Throne of Grace back print: a carved arch framing the cross above olive branches

front.alt: Throne of Grace front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: Open shackles hang beneath the wordmark, the chain between them snapped clean.
story.back: Open shackles and a snapped chain under the wordmark
story.paraphrase: Christ set us free so that we would stay free. Stand firm.

back.alt: Freed in Awe back print: open shackles beneath the thorn wreath

front.alt: Freed in Awe front: small mark on the chest

story.art: A great round stone rests beside an open tomb, morning light behind it.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, coal ink
story.back: The rolled stone and open tomb under the wordmark
story.paraphrase: They looked up and saw the heavy stone already rolled aside.

back.alt: Stone Rolled Aside back print: the lily over the open tomb

front.alt: Stone Rolled Aside front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: Twin columns rise into an unbroken arch, a thorn vine running along the keystone.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, bone ink
story.back: Columns and arch with a thorn vine above the wordmark
story.paraphrase: We are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, so we worship with awe.

back.alt: Unshaken Kingdom back print: the thorn wreath under an arch

front.alt: Unshaken Kingdom front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: A single chain splits at its center link, both halves falling away from a lily.
story.back: Split chain and lily under the wordmark
story.paraphrase: He led them out of darkness and deep gloom and snapped their chains.

back.alt: Chains Snapped back print: a lily between the halves of a broken chain

front.alt: Chains Snapped front: small mark on the chest

story.art: Lilies rise from the threshold of an empty tomb.
story.front: Small Thorn Cross, left chest, coal ink
story.back: Lilies at the tomb's threshold under the wordmark
story.paraphrase: He is not here. He has risen, just as he said he would.

back.alt: He Is Risen back print: lilies rising

front.alt: He Is Risen front: small Thorn Cross on the left chest

story.art: The small Thorn Cross, embroidered in bone thread on the front panel.
story.front: Embroidered Thorn Cross, front panel, bone thread
story.back: Small embroidered wordmark above the strap
story.paraphrase: Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

back.alt: Thornbound Cap: embroidered Thorn Cross on the front panel

story.art: A thorn wreath embroidered in bone thread on the front panel.
story.front: Embroidered thorn wreath, front panel, bone thread
story.back: Small embroidered wordmark above the strap
story.paraphrase: His kingdom is everlasting. He rules through every generation.

back.alt: Kingdom Cap: embroidered thorn wreath on the front panel
